headline: New RULES from July 1: An Inconspicuous Change Could COMPLICATE Early Retirement!
summary: A change effective July 1 in Slovakia raised the minimum early retirement pension along with the increase in the subsistence minimum. The change may affect planned early retirements.
why: Pension rules set by the state determine retirement income for workers and affect public spending and household finances.
